name: Lunje - Sutorman
description_md:
Lunje to Sutorman is a waymarked hiking route in ME signedpost as 771A. It is part of the national waymarked hiking network and covers a distance of 30.2 km.

The difficulty is hard, which is derived from the distance and ascent. Walkers face 1538 m of ascent and 1449 m of descent across mountain paths with some exposure, graded SAC T2. The walking time takes about 12 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.
